title: Defy Gravity
description: Discover the mind-bending science behind quantum levitation

scenes.narration: Imagine a world where objects float in mid-air, defying gravity
This is made possible by quantum levitation, a phenomenon where superconductors
are cooled to extremely low temperatures, allowing them to expel magnetic fields
Creating an upward force that counteracts the weight of the object
Essentially, the superconductor is floating on a cushion of magnetic field
And that's the incredible science behind quantum levitation, defying gravity one experiment at a time

title: Defy Gravity

scenes.narration: Imagine objects floating in mid-air, defying gravity's pull

And it's all thanks to the incredible power of quantum physics, where the impossible becomes possible
